name: Seafood hotpot
summary: Seafood hotpot is a shared Châu Đốc dinner: vegetables, mushrooms, noodles, and herbs blanched at the table in a boiling hot-and-sour soup. It is a separate order from lẩu mắm.
origin: One of the shared dinners in Châu Đốc, alongside lẩu mắm.
howToEat: Order it for the table. Drop the vegetables, mushrooms, noodles, and herbs into the hot-and-sour soup and eat them as they cook.
Lẩu mắm is the fermented-fish pot. This one is the hot-and-sour soup.
where: Town restaurants in Châu Đốc, for a shared dinner.
seoDescription: Seafood hotpot in Châu Đốc is a shared hot-and-sour soup where you cook vegetables, mushrooms, noodles, and herbs at the table.
